notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2678: Both complete originals independently read. Jundab supplies his participation, the source-named Abdullah-bin-Ghalib commission, the actual Qadid encounter and capture, Harith's explanation, the two conditional replies and the final tying. Preserve the printed name order without canonical correction, the destination, the one-day/one-night duration and the if-Muslim/if-not-Muslim distinction. Do not convert the historical dialogue into an unqualified present rule.
notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2688: Both entire originals independently read. Anas reports the eighty Meccans, the stated Fajr/descent intention, capture without resistance, release and the resulting verse-revelation report. Preserve the quantity, actual order and the verse with its supplied translation as the identified content of that narrated event; no separate recitation is invented. Hindi's numeral duplicates its spelled eighty without altering the quantity. The surah/verse locator and Urdu's to-the-end-of-the-verse omission pointer are apparatus; do not supply any omitted verse continuation.
notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2690: Both complete originals independently read. The short Ibn-Abbas/Umar told-me frame is actual reception attribution, followed by Badr, taking ransom, the supplied revelation report and the final permissibility statement. Preserve actual quoted and translated wording, including the source's incomplete Hindi middle and Urdu's limited quotation/range, without filling missing verse text. The disbeliever parenthesis supplies the source-rendered participant/object referent and remains qualified; the surah/verse locator is context. Hindi's ghanayim/spoils-of-war parenthesis is a duplicate term definition and may remain lexical context. No malformed Hindi text or external reference is repaired.
notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2696: Both entire originals independently read. Preserve the actual attributed Ali episode separating the enslaved woman from her child, the ensuing prohibition and annulment of the sale. The subsequent explicitly introduced Abu-Dawud discussion of Maymun not meeting Ali and the dates of deaths/battles is transmission-critical chronology apparatus. Retain that entire appendix as source context, without creating separate narrative children from the dates or certifying the chain.
